mostWorthwhile.text: Building the bone-cell lineage was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects matrix-producing osteoblasts with embedded osteocytes and their channels.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive joint additions were clear but predictable, with only one combination offered at each step.

surprise.text: The planned vessel cutaway distinguishes nutrients travelling to bone cells from red cells staying inside the vessel, clarifying how embedded cells are supplied.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though the terms osteoblast, osteocyte and synovial capsule could use brief definitions for students unfamiliar with anatomy.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the skeleton gains movement from muscles, although the mostly forced sequence offered limited decisions.
